item.title: Jesus Our Bridegroom: Finding True Love That Fills the Empty Heart
item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, we explore the biblical truth of Jesus as our Bridegroom and how the gospel offers lasting love, hope, and healing for the empty heart.

item.title: God’s Justice Stands Firm Even When Life Feels Unfair (Job 34–35)
item.description: In Job 34–35, Elihu defends the perfect justice, righteousness, and impartiality of God. These chapters call us to trust God’s justice even when life feels unfair and point us to Christ where justice and mercy meet.

item.title: Biblical Manhood: Servant Leadership, Responsibility, and Repentance
item.description: What does it mean to be a godly man in a confused age? In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins continues the February 2026 series Marriage & Family: God’s Design for the Home by examining biblical manhood through the lens of Scripture. From Genesis 2:15 to Ephesians 5:25, this message shows that biblical manhood is neither harsh nor passive but marked by responsibility, humility, repentance, and sacrificial love.

item.title: Covenant Love: The Foundation of a Strong, God-Honoring Marriage
item.description: Marriage is not sustained by emotion, compatibility, or shared interests. According to Scripture, marriage is upheld by covenant love—a binding, God-ordained commitment rooted in God’s own faithfulness. Anchored in Malachi 2:14, this episode explains why marriage is not a contract to abandon when it becomes difficult, but a covenant to be kept because God has kept His covenant with us in Christ.

item.title: Katie Souza’s “Spirit of Death” Teaching Examined in Light of Scripture
item.description: Biblical analysis of Katie Souza’s spirit of death teaching, testing her claims against Scripture and addressing word-of-faith and courts of heaven errors.

item.title: God’s Greatness Revealed in the Storm (Job 36–37)
item.description: In Job 36–37, Elihu lifts Job’s eyes from suffering to the greatness of God revealed in creation, discipline, and divine sovereignty.

item.title: The Fear of the Lord: Reverent Trust That Shapes the Christian Life
item.description: In this episode of Anchored in the Word, Dave Jenkins explains the biblical meaning of the fear of the Lord. Far from terror, the fear of God is reverent trust that leads to wisdom, worship, obedience, and freedom from the fear of man. Drawing from Psalm 111, Proverbs 1, Hebrews 12, and Acts, this episode shows how the fear of the Lord shapes everyday Christian living.
